shortDescription: Commander, I will not lie to you, it's a mess out there. The battlefield is fluid and priorities are changing on a minute-to-minute basis. I need you to get a force out in the field and be ready for anything. You will be provided targets and priorities as matters develop on the ground. This is a test for this mission shape. Be warned, this is a long and shifting mission.
longDescription: No clocks. Finish each task in order.

contractObjectiveList.title: Complete all Objectives and then Extract

dialogueContent.words: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} HQ is getting additional tasks ready for us, but first off, we need destroy the garrison to the south-east.
New order, Commander, there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} officer they want taken down west of your drop zone.
Enemy officer is down. HQ needs us over that hill to take the Valley Base.
Commander, new orders, there's a friendly north of the drop zone in need of a rescue.
Friendly will be onboard soon, hold position.
Friendly is onboard. Get them to the evac zone.
